items.html: And the Hei of Elokim of Bina: its form is Dalet-Vav. For the aspect of ZA within the Mochin of Bina has already grown in the secret of the pregnancy, and has become the form of a Vav, except that it has no head. And it is a hint that he is already the possessor of VAK, except that they are in the aspect of three included in three, as is known. Also another reason: behold, ZON are in pregnancy within Bina, and they are hinted at in the two letters Dalet-Vav, from which the form of the Hei of Bina is made, as above. Therefore this Hei has the form Dalet-Vav.
